_comment: Event calendar template. `onsale_date` drives the E3 grievance clock, so a
wrong date silently distorts the headline time exhibit. Every date must be
sourced from the ticketing platform's own announcement, the venue calendar,
or contemporaneous press, and the source recorded in `source_note`.
The entries below are PLACEHOLDERS with null dates. They will fail
load_events() until filled in. That is deliberate: an unsourced date is

venue_class: LCSD_EXEMPT   - venue managed by LCSD and understood to fall outside the
Places of Public Entertainment Ordinance licensing regime
via the Cap. 172D exemption order. VERIFY against the
primary legislation before this classification is used in
any published claim; it is the paper's central legal fact.
This split is the closest thing the project has to a policy contrast:
it is an institutional classification, not a randomised assignment, so it
supports description and not a causal estimate.
real_name_registration: true / false / null when unknown. Enables the descriptive contrast between
events that did and did not use real-name ticketing. Selection into
real-name registration is not random - high-demand shows adopt it - so
this contrast is suggestive only and must be labelled as such.
